base.meaning: the OBS-SPLIT-CHANNELS ship state: obs v2 (80 = 64 frozen legacy + 16 pad-split), P3 export harness 1b6d7749 frozen beneath it, the Type-A command adapter 9808dc94 beneath that

rule_0.statement: THE FIRST-SKILL THEORY. A small PPO actor reading the v2 observation schema (80ch: gait phase, contacts, pad-split, prior commands, interventions) plus 2 declared goal channels, emitting ONE command through the Type-A adapter's declared channel {commanded_target_velocity_x} (the only P0-demonstrated graded authority), can add flat-ground goal tracking (reach a waypoint dead ahead) through the walk's untouched reflex layer, export through P3's frozen harness, and meet the hard conditions in the CPU-exact engine. The skill's PURPOSE is exercising the full pipeline (GPU env -> training -> frozen export -> CPU inference -> exact closed-loop acceptance); passing it does NOT establish learning was necessary -- the scripted baseline settles that question, which is why the baseline is built and measured on the same bars.
rule_0.prediction: Within 1M decisions per seed, at least one of the three fixed seeds yields a checkpoint whose exported closed-loop runs reach the waypoint in every eval episode without a fall, with CoT within the baseline-measured band, in less median time-to-waypoint than the scripted baseline.

falsifiers_declared_before_any_training_.F-FIRST-SKILL: FIRES if the trained policy does not beat the scripted baseline on the acceptance bars under the frozen ranking: worst training seed (of the 3) must have (a) reach_rate strictly greater than the baseline's on the fixed eval seed set, (b) median time-to-waypoint strictly less than the baseline's median over paired eval episodes, (c) no-fall rate 1.0, (d) CoT within the measured band. If a scripted controller matches the trained policy on every bar, F-FIRST-SKILL FIRES and the record carries it: passing the pipeline does not establish learning was necessary.
falsifiers_declared_before_any_training_.F-EXPORT-VALID: FIRES if the frozen export through P3's harness (tools/science_funnel/typeb_export, policy_manifest + run_f_cpu_policy_bytes machinery) does not reproduce the training-time policy's actions BIT-EXACTLY (float32 byte stream) on the fixed observation fixture set (4096 observations: the first 4096 observations of the eval rollouts at the selected checkpoint, digest-pinned at freeze). Two fresh-process CPU replays must also be byte-identical to each other (the P3 F-CPU-POLICY-BYTES clause).
falsifiers_declared_before_any_training_.F-ACCEPTANCE-EXACT: FIRES if the exported policy's closed-loop run in the CPU-exact engine (ChimeraEngine gait_unit + the command adapter, the exact CPU kernel) fails ANY hard condition -- a fall (any engine budget refusal before tick 270) on any eval episode, or CoT outside the measured band -- or fails the frozen ranking of F-FIRST-SKILL. Hard conditions are enforced independently; NO blended score exists anywhere in this manifest.

carried_from_the_shared_envelope.F-OBSERVATION-LEAK: the P3 schema audit governs: any privileged field in the deployed actor input fires
carried_from_the_shared_envelope.F-CREDIT-BLOCKED: the adapter's F-G42 command census (echo, achieved-velocity tracker, veto horizon) gates on every training run: if the command channel cannot meaningfully affect the task, this fires
carried_from_the_shared_envelope.F-REFLEX-REGRESSION: the walk's protected-condition suite (the wave-38 banked red set) must be unchanged by any training-consumption wiring

task.statement: reach a waypoint placed d_wp ahead of the body's initial heading on flat ground, through speed commands only; no terrain, no heading authority, no vision, no multi-gait

waypoint.placement: on the body's initial +heading axis at distance d_wp from the initial CoM x
waypoint.d_wp_derivation: reachable inside the eval window across the measured envelope's upper band: at the banked in-band mid command 0.60 m/s the reach time is 0.50/0.60 s = 250 ticks + measured onset ~7-10 ticks, inside the 270-tick window with the walk's own banked life (refusals observed at 297-302) intact

task.reach_disc_derivation: one decision period of travel at the measured envelope ceiling: v_seed * T_decision = 0.7636247890 * 15/300 = 0.0381812394 m; the disc is exactly the distance the body covers per decision at its own banked ceiling -- no tighter (unmeasurable), no looser (a free ride)

timing_and_clock.decision_tick_rule: decisions at ticks 0,15,30,...; command zero-order-held at tick boundaries (the adapter's banked ZOH semantics, F-ZOH-CLOCK proven: value-only hold)
timing_and_clock.episode_cap_derivation: the walk's own banked end-of-life region (refusals observed at ticks 297-302 under held commands); the episode ends at the engine's own refusal or tick 300, whichever first -- the cap never cuts a live walk shorter than its own machinery would
timing_and_clock.eval_window_derivation: 0.9 of the banked 302-tick life, rounded down to a whole decision grid (270 = 18 x 15); the margin below the natural refusal is the no-fall bar's headroom

hard_conditions.note: these live ONLY here and in acceptance.py -- never in the reward, never blended
hard_conditions.no_fall: an episode is a FALL iff the engine refuses (any budget class) before tick 270. no_fall_rate = fraction of eval episodes with no fall; the hard bar is 1.0 for the trained policy's worst seed.
hard_conditions.reach: an episode REACHES iff body CoM x >= x_wp - reach_disc_radius at any tick in [60, 270]. reach window starts at tick 60 (the banked entry/settle era: commands issue from tick 0 but the machinery's measured onset is 7-10 ticks and the walk's first strides carry the entry settle); reach_rate = fraction of eval episodes reaching.
hard_conditions.time_to_waypoint: first tick in [60, 270] with CoM x >= x_wp - reach_disc_radius; undefined (recorded as INF) if no reach.

cot_within_band.definition: CoT = E_episode / (m_body * d_reached); E_episode = the engine's cumulative mechanical-work ledger over the episode; m_body = 13824.5 kg (the measured membrane inventory at water density); d_reached = the along-heading CoM displacement achieved by episode end (honest denominator whether or not the waypoint is reached)
cot_within_band.band_rule_frozen_now: the band is MEASURED, not assumed: the scripted baseline runs first on the identical eval protocol on the identical CPU-exact engine; its per-episode CoTs are recorded and frozen into the acceptance ledger BEFORE any policy checkpoint is compared. A policy passes iff median(CoT_policy) <= median(CoT_baseline) + (max(CoT_baseline) - median(CoT_baseline)) -- i.e. not above the baseline's own worst measured efficiency. Every term is measured; zero constants are invented. With a deterministic engine and 5 eval episodes the spread term may be 0, in which case the bar is exact parity with the baseline's efficiency.

ranking_rule_frozen_now.comparison: trained policy (WORST of the 3 training seeds, evaluated with deterministic mean actions on the fixed eval seed set) vs the scripted baseline on the same set
must_hold_all: reach_rate(policy_worst_seed) > reach_rate(baseline) (strictly more episodes reached; with 5 eval episodes this is >= 1 episode)

median(time_to_waypoint over reached episodes, policy_worst_seed) < median(time_to_waypoint, baseline) over paired eval episodes (paired by eval seed; both-INF pairs excluded, an INF on the policy side cannot win)
ranking_rule_frozen_now.baseline_role: per Astra: a scripted controller may match the trained policy; if it does, F-FIRST-SKILL fires and the honest record is that the pipeline passed but learning was not established as necessary

algorithm.name: PPO
algorithm.reference: RSL-RL LeggedRobotPPO published defaults (github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl; Rudin et al., Learning to Walk in Minutes) -- cited defaults, not tuned taste
algorithm.budget_declaration: 1M-decision registered pilot budget (astra-typeb-pilots P3): the iteration grid floors under 1,000,000; a pilot, NOT a convergence claim -- an explicitly new registration is required for any further training
algorithm.critic: same trunk widths; critic input = actor input + privileged training-only block (true CoM pose, waypoint world coords) which cannot leak into the deployed actor (the P3 manifest bans privileged deployed fields; the actor input is 82 declared non-privileged channels)

action_space.mapping: a = (tanh(u)+1)/2 * V_CEILING with V_CEILING = 0.7636247890 m/s (the banked measured envelope ceiling, command_adapter receipt seed_v_m_s): in-envelope by construction; the walk's existing annulus clamp governs any residual
action_space.walk_interface_8ch: UNTOUCHED and UNLEARNED in skill-1: the reflex layer owns the walk's own action vector entirely (Astra architecture: frozen mode-aware derived controller driven by learned low-dimensional commands)

actor_input.composition: 80 = the OBS v2 schema (OBS_SCHEMA_VERSION 2, the 73f3a860 frozen table) + 2 declared goal channels: [dist_to_wp / d_wp, com_vel_x_heading / v_seed] (goal geometry is task input, non-privileged; the second channel restates an existing obs channel in goal-normalized form for the actor's convenience)
actor_input.availability: the training env provides all 82 channels every decision (live engine, instrument contract pad_pair_ordering='heel_mp'); no mean-fill is exercised at training time; the availability-mask recipe activates only on recorded-trace replay through the P3 harness

seeds.eval_protocol: fixed initial states (one per eval seed: the walk's seed entry state re-derived per seed), waypoint at d_wp on the initial heading, deterministic mean actions, same CPU-exact engine as acceptance

curriculum: NONE -- flat ground only; the terrain curriculum is skill-2+ and has no registration here

checkpoint_selection_frozen_now.eval_cadence: eval rollouts on the fixed eval seed set every 25,000 decisions (40 evals across the 983,040-decision run; the executor wires the eval callback at the decision grid, framework defaults do not set this)
checkpoint_selection_frozen_now.selection_rule: the shipped checkpoint is the one with the BEST MEAN RETURN (sum of the frozen shaping reward over the 5 eval episodes) among the LAST 10% of evals (evals 37..40, i.e. decision counts 900000..975000); ties break to the EARLIEST
checkpoint_selection_frozen_now.selection_is_not_acceptance: the selection rule picks WHICH candidate to export; acceptance is only ever the hard conditions + ranking on the CPU-exact engine

reward_frozen.see: tools/science_funnel/first_skill/reward.py (the runnable form) -- shaping ONLY, normalized O(1), never acceptance
reward_frozen.r_progress: per decision: (delta CoM x projected on the body-to-waypoint axis) / (v_seed * T_decision), clipped to [-1, 1]; at the banked seed speed this reads exactly +1 per decision
reward_frozen.r_heading: per decision: w_head * (cos(psi_err) - 1), psi_err = angle of the CoM velocity vector off the body-to-waypoint axis from the declared obs channels; in [-2*w_head, 0]; strictly a penalty for steering effort off-axis
reward_frozen.w_head_derivation: SUBORDINATION INEQUALITY, frozen: the heading term's worst-case episode total (2 * w_head * N_dec = 2*0.1*20 = 4.0) must not exceed one third of the progress term's reach-scale total (d_wp/(v_seed*T_dec) = 13.096; one third = 4.365): no amount of heading shaping can buy a non-reaching episode above a reaching one. w_head = 0.1 is the largest value in the declared candidate set {0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0} satisfying it.
excluded: NO alive bonus -- the alive bonus is the documented crouch disease (training_gate.py header): collecting a survival term while satisfying nothing
NO terminal success/failure term -- that is acceptance leaking into the reward; the missing future progress after a fall IS the penalty, honestly
NO effort/energy penalty in skill-1 -- the walk's own budgets and the CoT acceptance band govern effort; a Joule term here would be an unmeasured scale smuggled into shaping
NO absolute target speed -- the task is reach-the-waypoint; a speed target would re-create the contradictory-reward failure the gate exists to refuse

baseline_frozen.controller: scripted, action-interface-identical to the trained policy (same adapter channel): issue commanded_target_velocity_x = 0.60 m/s ONCE at tick 0 and hold (exactly the banked R2 run's value and ZOH semantics, byte-proven veto-free 140 ticks post-onset in the command_adapter receipt); no stop logic, no observation feedback -- a fixed schedule
baseline_frozen.value_derivation: 0.60 m/s is the banked R2 in-band mid command (the F-ZOH-CLOCK twin's value): the ONLY non-seed command value the ship state has measured end-to-end; choosing it makes the baseline a banked behavior, not a tuned one
baseline_frozen.measured_on_same_bars: the baseline is evaluated on the identical eval seed set, identical episode rules, identical hard conditions and CoT band protocol, on the identical CPU-exact engine; its record (reach rate, no-fall, time-to-waypoint, CoT band) is frozen into the acceptance ledger BEFORE any policy comparison

export_frozen.harness: tools/science_funnel/typeb_export (the 1b6d7749 frozen harness): policy_manifest (validate -- architecture[0]==observation.dim, action.dim==architecture[-1], param/MAC accounting, privileged ban, clock 20*15==300, weights sha) + the deterministic numpy CPU recipe + the fresh-process byte-identity machinery
export_frozen.manifest_kind: typeb_policy_manifest with observation.dim 82, architecture [82,128,128,1], action.dim 1 -- validator-compatible with ZERO amendments (verified at prestage)
export_frozen.fixture_set: the first 4096 observations of the eval rollouts at the selected checkpoint, digest-pinned at export time, named in the acceptance ledger before comparison

gpu_env_contract.env_class: FirstSkillGoalEnv -- the GPU-env lane's wrapper: batched gait_unit bodies + the command adapter channel + waypoint bookkeeping; physics 300 Hz, decisions every 15 ticks, obs v2 (80) + goal (2), action = the adapter channel (1) through the declared mapping
invariants: the reflex layer, budgets, and walk interface are byte-shared with the CPU-exact engine (F-REFLEX-REGRESSION governs)
the env exposes the engine's own refusal classes as episode termination, never as an env-invented failure
per-environment seed isolation (Astra F-BATCH-COUPLING fixtures apply to this env)

budget_and_stop.wall_clock_expectation: NONE registered -- a pilot records its measured throughput; Astra F-GPU-TRAINING-BUDGET governs the GPU-env lane separately
stop_conditions: the run stops at 10 iterations (983,040 decisions) per seed, always
a mid-run engine-side falsifier (F-CREDIT-BLOCKED via the F-G42 census, F-REFLEX-REGRESSION) stops the run and the record carries it
no re-run, re-seed, or budget extension without an explicitly new registration

no_tuning_clause: no reward weight, window, threshold, bar, seed, cadence, or selection rule in this manifest is adjusted after any training or evaluation result is inspected. Amendments create a NEW registration and preserve this one and all earlier results (the acceleration-pilots doctrine).
